scope_note: Covers every MU-5, MU-6, MU-11 height rule and yard/setback rule in the verified set (37 rules). Uses-per-story rules (MU-5-09, MU-6-09, MU-11-05), lot area/width rules (MU-5-16, MU-6-16, MU-11-11), and MU-OPENSPACE-01 are NOT height/yard rules and were excluded from this package. MU-5-15 / MU-6-15 (building form separation, 6 ft) are yard-like separation rules and are included.

gaps.detail: the stored ambiguity_note for MU-5-06 states the maximum front setback functions as a build-to-line control (front must sit between 10 and 20 ft); no verbatim code quote of that build-to-line mechanics is stored — the quote itself gives only the numbers

notes: All building-form scoping is grounded in the verbatim applies_to field of each rule; the numeric values come from the verbatim stored quotes. The verified set tiers MU-5 and MU-6 into three building-form groups: (1) urban house / two-family dwelling / cottage development, (2) row house, (3) multifamily residential / storefront / vertical mixed-use; MU-11 has only two tiers in the set (row house; multifamily / storefront / vertical mixed-use) — no urban-house-form MU-11 height/yard rules are stored. Only four rules state use applicability in the quote (MU-5-11, MU-5-12, MU-6-11, MU-6-12 — ground floor residential vs non-residential occupancy) and only MU-5-12, MU-6-12, MU-11-02, MU-11-07, MU-11-08 state street/location applicability; the rest are silent and recorded as gaps rather than inferred. The MU-5 and MU-6 sets are structurally identical except: MU-6-10 max height is 65 ft vs MU-5-10 55 ft; MU-6-13/MU-6-14 abutting lists include RMF-35 while MU-5-13/MU-5-14 do not. MU-11-04 rear-yard minimum was human-verified at 10 feet (legislative strike-through on the 5 resolved by Rohan, 2026-09-23).
